title: Mt._Ember
lead_summary:
The first time the player comes to Mt. Ember, they can only access the western side that has Team Rocket's Hideout and Moltres. There are also some Corsolas on the beach who are blocking access to a TM. They can be scared away using a Mareanie, Toxapex, or the Mareanie Doll found on Kin Island.
Once the player has obtained Dive, they can take the eastern path from Kindle Road to access the other side and climb the Volcano to enter the Ruby Chamber.
